name: django admin: sign in and add a group (mobile-390)
description: Signs in as labadmin, adds the group "Lab reviewers" and expects the new group in the list (Django's success message is a plain <ul class=messagelist> with no ARIA role or live region, so the lab's `message` expectation cannot see it). A flow step value is a literal, so prepare.sh writes the disposable password into the scratch copy of this file (git-ignored, mode 0600); the committed template holds a placeholder. Run the copy in the scratch directory, not this template.

steps.label: signed-out visit lands on the login form
